articles.title: New Play Area Under Construction in Alkrington, Middleton
articles.excerpt: Rochdale Council has commenced work on a new play area at Mainway Meadows in Alkrington, alongside enhancements to existing facilities at Sandy Park and Kirkway Stocks Play Park.
articles.content_html:
Rochdale Council has begun construction on a new play area at Mainway Meadows, located between Mainway and Moss Way in Alkrington. The project aims to provide a safe and inclusive space for children of various ages and abilities, featuring accessible pathways, safety fencing, and a range of play equipment including swings, a slide, seesaw, roundabout, seating, and a children’s picnic table.

The work at Mainway Meadows is expected to take approximately four to five weeks to complete. This initiative is funded by Middleton Township, which aims to enhance play facilities for local families and create a welcoming environment for children.

In addition to the new play area, improvements to the existing play area at Sandy Park are nearing completion. Councillor Dylan Williams expressed enthusiasm about the new equipment being installed at Kirkway Stocks Play Park, also known as Farmway or Sandy Park, which will further enrich the recreational options available to residents.

These developments reflect the council's commitment to enhancing community spaces and ensuring that children in Alkrington have access to quality play facilities. Local families can look forward to enjoying these upgraded amenities in the coming weeks.
